broker_credit_agricole.description: Import from Crédit Agricole exports (CSV or XLSX), uploaded together as one set: the 'Lista Movimenti Deposito Titoli' securities movements and the 'Lista Movimenti Conto' account movements. Each coupon, purchase, redemption and maturity is imported once, with the cash the account states; the opening balance of the Excel export starts the cash, and a stretch with no account export becomes a proposed cash correction.
broker_credit_agricole.name: Crédit Agricole
